name: query-database
description: Lists the rows, or entries, of a Notion database, one page at a time, with Notion's own filter and sorts, and answers each row's id, url, last_edited_time and properties as plain values keyed by property name: title and text as text, select and status by name, people by name, relations by id, dates as start or { start, end }; a row whose relation Notion cut short names it in incompleteRelations. The dataSourceId is the id notion__search-pages-and-databases answers for a result of object data_source. A row's id is what notion__get-page, notion__update-page-properties and notion__add-comment take. nextCursor, or null at the end, is the startCursor of the next page.

dataSourceId.description: The Notion data source ID to query.

filter.description: A Notion data source filter object.

sorts.description: Notion sort objects applied in order.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 20.

startCursor.description: Opaque next cursor from an earlier query.
